schoolName: School of the Art Institute of Chicago

rationale.intuition: SAIC overall admit rate ~65-72% (notably high; SAIC casts a wide net and is mission-driven to recruit). Mid-tier portfolio + 3.5 GPA + 1280 SAT comfortably within admit pool. Industry: solid portfolio applicants at SAIC consistently cluster 50-75% — this is one of the most accessible BFA-track art schools. Engine triggers ART_DESIGN sentinel (probability=0, insufficientData) even though SAIC's high admit rate suggests engine COULD anchor to overallAcceptanceRate if the audition-school short-circuit were tier-aware.

sources.name: SAIC Admissions Facts 2024
sources.evidence: Overall admit rate ~67%; portfolio is required but SAIC's holistic review philosophy weights essays, recommendations, and demonstrated artistic curiosity alongside the portfolio

sources.name: NACAC Art School Admit Pool Benchmarks 2023
sources.evidence: SAIC, MICA, Pratt fall in the 50-72% admit range for moderately-qualified portfolios; below MidEastern art-design selectivity tier

sources.name: Counselor Engine isAuditionOrPortfolioSchool
sources.evidence: institutionType=ART_DESIGN unconditionally triggers insufficientData regardless of school's underlying selectivity. This fixture exposes that the short-circuit fails to discriminate between Curtis-tier (~5%) and SAIC-tier (~67%) art schools.

wontFix.reason: Engine's ART_DESIGN short-circuit is binary — does not account for the wide selectivity range within portfolio schools. SAIC at 67% admit and CalArts at 24% are treated identically (both decline to predict).
wontFix.followUp: Improve audition/portfolio handler to fall back to overallAcceptanceRate × profileContext when school has a high published admit rate.
